note: The scene1 tutorial fight — the official starter (species 68) against the Bunny encounter (species 34) — walked by the real projection instead of the isolation rigs. `golden-traits.json` grades one characteristic and `golden-physical-traits.json` grades one talent, each against a dummy; these rows grade the composition the battle actually runs: which talent a roll answers, what the permanent-stat resolver makes of it, what `onBattleEnter` leaves on the two HUD units, and then the whole P7 strike in the runtime's own order — projectTargetDefenseIgnorePercent, computeDamage through the status-attempt bridge, projectMissChance, the hit roll, the plan, beforeDirectDamage, the unit's own outgoing and incoming projection, the commit, afterDirectDamage, the item-10 HP floor, afterDamage and afterSkillAction — with tickDesignBleeding and onRoundEnd closing each round. A strike is graded as a walk: the draws are the stream in ask order, so a hook run one step early or a projection skipped shows up as a different number rather than a passing average.
